HeroSheet.Label: Aventuria Helper: Hero Sheet
HeroSheet.AbilityUsedTooltip: Mark special ability as used (changeable even in play mode)

Probe.Title: {attribute} check
Probe.Hint: Positive values make the check easier and are subtracted from the result. Negative values make the check harder and are added.

Welcome.Title: Welcome to Aventuria
Welcome.Intro: Welcome, hero! This guide walks you through the Aventuria tools in Foundry step by step.

GettingStarted.Heading: Getting Started
GettingStarted.PlannedAutomation: This step is planned to be automated by the Aventuria Helpers module later on.
GettingStarted.MissingPack: Compendium not found. Is the Aventuria module active?

Users.Title: Create users
Users.Body: Create a separate Foundry user for every player with the Gamemaster role - not the lower Player role. Aventuria needs this role for everyone at the table.

Language.Title: Set the language
Language.Body: In the game settings, set the language to German or English so Aventuria is localized correctly.

Scene.Title: Import the game board
Scene.Body: Imports the Gameboard scene from the Aventuria module's scene compendium directly into your world and activates it.
Scene.AlreadyImported: Gameboard was already imported - activated it again.
Scene.NotFound: No matching gameboard scene found in the compendium.

Macros.Title: Import the macros
Macros.Body: Imports the macros from the Aventuria module's macro compendium directly into the "Aventuria Macros" folder in your macro directory.
Macros.AlreadyImported: All macros are already in your macro directory.

PrepareBoard.Title: Prepare the board
PrepareBoard.Body: Runs the Aventuria macro Prepare Board directly.
PrepareBoard.MissingApi: The Aventuria module is not active, or its API isn't available.

PlaceStacks.Title: Place decks and stacks
PlaceStacks.Body: Automatically places the piles and decks created by Prepare Board at their spot on the Gameboard scene, locks them there, and shuffles the fate stack.
PlaceStacks.MissingCcm: Complete Card Management is not active.
PlaceStacks.GmOnly: Only the gamemaster can place decks and stacks.
PlaceStacks.WrongScene: This only works on the Gameboard scene from the Aventuria module.
PlaceStacks.NotPrepared: None of the stacks were found. Run Prepare Board first.

ImportTokens.Title: Import tokens
ImportTokens.Body: Imports the game's marker tokens (life points, Fertigkeit, plus/minus, fate points, etc.) from the Aventuria module's Actor compendium directly into the "Aventuria Tokens" folder in your Actor directory, and places them automatically at their spot on the Gameboard scene.
ImportTokens.AlreadyImported: All tokens are already in your Actor directory.
ImportTokens.NotFound: No "Tokens" folder found in the Actor compendium.
ImportTokens.Placed: Placed {count} of {total} tokens on the Gameboard.
ImportTokens.GmOnly: Only the gamemaster can place tokens on the Gameboard.
ImportTokens.NoScene: No scene is open - tokens were imported, but not placed.
ImportTokens.WrongScene: Placing only works on the Gameboard scene from the Aventuria module - tokens were imported, but not placed.

AssignHero.Title: Assign hero
AssignHero.Body: Creates the hero for a player: pick player, table slot and hero - the hero sheet and deck are set up automatically. Replaces an existing hero for that player.
AssignHero.GmOnly: Only the gamemaster can assign a hero.

PlaceStacks.Title: Place on the Gameboard scene
PlaceStacks.Body: Places the deck, discard pile, hand and token of the hero chosen in step 1 on the Gameboard and shuffles the deck.
PlaceStacks.MissingCcm: Complete Card Management is not active.
PlaceStacks.GmOnly: Only the gamemaster can anchor a hero's deck, discard pile, hand and token.
PlaceStacks.WrongScene: This only works on the Gameboard scene from the Aventuria module.
PlaceStacks.NotPrepared: No prepared hero found. Run Assign hero first.
PlaceStacks.NotConfigured: Player slot {player} hasn't been measured yet.
PlaceStacks.Done: Anchored the stacks and token for player slot {player}, shuffled the deck.

AssignDialog.Title: Assign hero
AssignDialog.Intro: Pick the player first, then their player slot on the Gameboard and the hero. If the player already has a slot, it's already selected; other players' slots are locked. Click the image itself for a large view.
AssignDialog.PlayerHasHero: {player} already has a hero ({hero}) - it will be deleted and replaced when you continue.
AssignDialog.PlayerHasHeroConfirmBody: This player already has the hero {hero} - it will be deleted and replaced.
AssignDialog.WrongScene: Open the Gameboard scene from the Aventuria module first.
AssignDialog.PrepareFailed: Could not create the hero - see the console for details.

PrepareHeroes.Title: Prepare Heroes
PrepareHeroes.Body: Draws each of the six Quick Start heroes' matching cards into their hand and plays four more out as Ausdauer. Assumes every participating player already has a hero assigned and placed on the Gameboard.
PrepareHeroes.GmOnly: Only the gamemaster can prepare the heroes.
PrepareHeroes.NoHeroes: None of the assigned heroes belong to the Quick Start.
PrepareHeroes.Done: Prepared the Quick Start for {count} hero(es).

PrepareAdventure.Title: Import Adventure
PrepareAdventure.Body: Imports Aventuria's Quick Start event cards and places the three needed cards directly on the Gameboard.
PrepareAdventure.GmOnly: Only the gamemaster can import the adventure.

PrepareHenchmen.Title: Prepare Henchmen
PrepareHenchmen.Body: Prepares the henchmen deck in the background, places it on the Gameboard, and shuffles it.
PrepareHenchmen.GmOnly: Only the gamemaster can prepare the henchmen.
PrepareHenchmen.Done: Prepared, placed, and shuffled the henchmen deck.

OpenJournal.Title: Open Adventure Journal
OpenJournal.Body: Opens the Aventuria Quick Start journal directly on the "The Adventure" page - this is where the adventure begins.

AdventureTool.Title: Play Adventure
AdventureTool.LockedBy: The Adventure Tool is currently being used by {user}. Wait until it's closed or released there.
AdventureTool.PickerIntro: Choose an adventure to start it.
AdventureTool.BrokenAdventure: The last active adventure could no longer be found (e.g. after a language change) - please choose a new one.
AdventureTool.EndConfirmBody: The current adventure will end and its progress will be reset. Continue?

HeroTray.Title: Hero Tray
HeroTray.DeleteHeroConfirmBody: {hero} as well as their deck, discard pile, hand and Im-Spiel-Stapel will be permanently deleted. Continue?
HeroTray.PreviewCards: Preview cards (look at the top cards)
HeroTray.PlayedTooltip: Played cards – cards in the Im-Spiel-Stapel that weren't played as Ausdauer
HeroTray.NoPlayRegion: No Ausdauer/play zone found on this scene.
HeroTray.NotEnoughEndurance: Not enough Ausdauer to play this card.
HeroTray.PlayCostBody: Costs {cost} Ausdauer, available: {ready}. Play it normally and pay the cost, or play it without Ausdauer?
HeroTray.EnduranceReadyTooltip: Available Ausdauer (cards not rotated in the Im-Spiel-Stapel)
HeroTray.EnduranceSpentTooltip: Spent Ausdauer (cards rotated in the Im-Spiel-Stapel)
HeroTray.DeckTooltip: Hero deck – the cards you can still draw
HeroTray.DiscardTooltip: Discard pile – cards already played or discarded
HeroTray.HandTooltip: Hand – the cards you currently hold
HeroTray.ReadyEndurance: Make Ausdauer ready (rotate a card back)

ResetCardRotations.Name: Reset card rotations
ResetCardRotations.MissingCcm: Complete Card Management is not active.
ResetCardRotations.GmOnly: Only the GM can reset card rotations.
ResetCardRotations.ConfirmBody: Should all cards on the scene be rotated back to their original position?

CleanUpBoard.Name: Clean up board
CleanUpBoard.MissingCcm: Complete Card Management is not active.
CleanUpBoard.GmOnly: Only the GM can clean up the board.
CleanUpBoard.WrongScene: This only works on the Gameboard scene from the Aventuria module.
CleanUpBoard.ConfirmBody: All cards will be removed from the scene (back into their decks/stacks) and the marker tokens will be reset to their starting position. Continue?
CleanUpBoard.Done: Board cleaned up: {count} card(s) removed, marker tokens reset.
